task7.note: Softmax is monotone in the logit, so the top-1/top-2 margin measures how far the 64-d feature sits from the runner-up decision direction.

task6.verdict: The 64-d representation of grape leaf.jpg is closer to BacterialSpot training examples than to Healthy ones: nearest class BacterialSpot at +0.936431 versus runner-up Irrelavant at +0.447695.

task11.method: Irrelavant probability from the unchanged production forward pass, compared across controlled input variants, the 17 external images and a stratified training sample. No threshold and no rejection rule was inspected, changed or applied.
findings: Irrelavant was top-1 for 0 of the 17 external images, yet for 1 of the 11 controlled variants of the SAME image, under framing changes only.
Its probability on grape leaf.jpg ranges from 0.016770 to 0.530499 across those variants, a 31.6-fold spread, with no change to the image content beyond crop and geometry.
The training distribution is strongly bimodal by design: genuine Irrelavant members carry a high probability, while genuine non-Irrelavant classes sit at p99 0.0836 and max 0.5063.
The class is therefore a visual-content class whose probability is strongly coupled to input framing; the measurements do not show it acting as a stable out-of-distribution detector.
